title: Tutoring Center Story Sprint Pack - Lower Sprint Lane

sprints.title: Moon Muffin Market Smell Map
sprints.sessionFit: 10-minute one-to-one warmup for a hesitant writer who can pick from concrete food and light details.
sprints.tutorSetup: Print one page, set out a pencil, and offer two market choices before writing starts.
sprints.kidDirection: Pick one muffin stall, add three tiny market details, and write one keeper sentence.
sprints.coachingPrompt: Ask which detail the reader can smell, see, or hear before asking for a full sentence.

pageSections.heading: Market Start
lines: The moon muffin stall smells like ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Tiny Job
lines: The market bell tells everyone to ____________________________.

sprints.wrapUpLine: One market detail I want to keep is ____________________________.
sprints.extensionLine: Add one more smell, color, or sound: ____________________________.

sprints.title: Puddle Planet Stamp Route
sprints.sessionFit: 10-minute tutoring warmup for a writer who needs a first, next, last path.
sprints.tutorSetup: Print one page, draw three small boxes on scrap paper, and let the writer point to a route choice.
sprints.kidDirection: Choose a bottle-cap stamp, plan three puddle stops, and write the delivery path in order.
sprints.coachingPrompt: Point to the three stops and ask what happens first, next, and last.

pageSections.heading: Stamp Pick
lines: The stamp means the note goes to ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Route Stops
lines: First, the mail cart rolls past ____________________________.
Next, the leaf boat floats near ____________________________.

sprints.wrapUpLine: The order word that helped me most is ____________________________.
sprints.extensionLine: Add one new puddle stop after the last stop: ____________________________.

sprints.title: Buttonwood Library Train Ticket Rule
sprints.sessionFit: 12-minute tutoring warmup for a writer who can make one simple rule and explain why it helps.
sprints.tutorSetup: Print one page, offer two train-stop choices, and model one short because sentence.
sprints.kidDirection: Make a ticket rule, choose a train stop, and write why the rule helps the tiny train.
sprints.coachingPrompt: Ask what the train needs to do calmly, then help the writer finish the because line.

pageSections.heading: Ticket Rule
lines: The ticket rule says each rider must ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Train Stop
lines: The shelf beside the stop holds ____________________________.
The quiet bell reminds riders to ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Reason Line
lines: Without the rule, the train might ____________________________.
With the rule, the train can ____________________________.

sprints.wrapUpLine: The rule I wrote clearly is ____________________________.
sprints.extensionLine: Add one more reason the rule helps: ____________________________.

sprints.title: Cloudberry Clocktower Missing Minute
sprints.sessionFit: 12-minute tutoring warmup for a writer who needs a concrete problem before drafting.
sprints.tutorSetup: Print one page, set a quiet timer, and let the writer choose a berry, bell, or stair detail.
sprints.kidDirection: Pick one missing minute, show where it went, and write the fix in one short scene.
sprints.coachingPrompt: Ask what changed at the clocktower and what small fix would help right away.

pageSections.heading: Clock Clue
lines: The missing minute is hiding near ____________________________.

sprints.wrapUpLine: The clearest fix in my scene is ____________________________.
sprints.extensionLine: Add one clocktower sound or color: ____________________________.

sprints.title: Tiny Lantern Reef Glow Path
sprints.sessionFit: 12-minute tutoring warmup for a writer who benefits from a map-like path and short direction words.
sprints.tutorSetup: Print one page, draw a simple three-dot path, and invite the writer to trace it before writing.
sprints.kidDirection: Choose a reef lantern, mark three glow stops, and write how the paper boat moves.
sprints.coachingPrompt: Ask the writer to use beside, under, around, or past in one line.

pageSections.heading: Glow Stops
lines: The first glow stop is near ____________________________.
The second glow stop curves around ____________________________.
The last glow stop waits past ____________________________.

sprints.wrapUpLine: The direction word I used best is ____________________________.
sprints.extensionLine: Add one new glow stop with a direction word: ____________________________.

sprints.title: Pencil Dragon Academy Door Redraw
sprints.sessionFit: 12-minute tutoring warmup for a writer who can improve one sentence without starting over.
sprints.tutorSetup: Print one page, give one pencil and one eraser, and say the goal is one better line.
sprints.kidDirection: Sketch a door idea in words, spot one confusing part, and redraw the sentence with a clearer choice.
sprints.coachingPrompt: Ask what the door should do, then offer one add, move, or replace choice.

pageSections.heading: Clearer Choice
lines: The clearer word I choose is ____________________________.

sprints.extensionLine: Add one clearer academy detail to the sentence: ____________________________.
